full_page.content:
1946, Jan. 8
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
10:40 P.M.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N. Y. JAN 8, 1946
Mrs. E. M. Barden.
Detroit, Michigan.
God bless you Mrs. Barden. Many thanks for your favor of the 6th -- your Son Rex's enrollment and the other poor sinner Solanus. Only when he gets to Heaven will he be fully converted. -- So keep on praying for him -- we'll pray for one another. ..
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of : Mrs. E. M. Barden 36511 Jefferson Ct. Farmington Hills, MI. 48018
